archive_rotation.scope: Cumulative checkpoints of rows committed when the store checkpoint transaction starts; both clocks must be at or before a cutoff selected after the FIFO commit barrier. Later commits can contain earlier clocks; no complete source frontier, feed coverage, market history, retention purge, or trading approval is inferred.

capture_report.trade_recovery_scope: Kraken only; committed WS tail or explicit recovery marker, with optional bounded automatic REST repair of forward gaps after acknowledgements. Bar state and other collectors start fresh; repaired active bars stay partial.
capture_report.bar_policy: Only locally closed bars; complete=false for partial first intervals or connection gaps. Empty intervals are not synthesized.

historical perpetual/funding archive and full volatility-index coverage
complete liquidation ledger and historical continuity; optional forceOrder snapshots are lossy

capture_report.freshness_scope: asset/feed aggregates and selected option instruments; not trading approval
capture_report.reference_caveat: Coinbase last-trade vs Kraken midpoint; Kraken has receipt time only. Public references are separate from testnet prices.
